fix: Add an `evolve failures` group over internal/failurelog. `list [--json] [--class C]` shows every failedApproaches entry (fingerprint, class, expiry) and the acknowledged fingerprints. `reset [--fingerprint fp]` performs the prune and ack that `loop --reset` performs. `prune [--dry-run]` removes only expired entries and never increments cycles_unpicked, which stays a per-batch step. `loop --reset` and the launch-time prune call the same functions. Exit 0, 2 on state I/O, 10 usage. Document the group in runtime-reference.md and point `loop --reset` at it.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: `evolve loop --reset [--fingerprint fp]` prunes infrastructure and ship-gate-config failedApproaches and acknowledges a blocker-breaker fingerprint (cmd_loop_maintenance.go:48-66). Every launch also prunes expired failedApproaches and carryoverTodos (lines 25-46). Both run only as part of starting a batch. Clearing a fingerprint before deciding whether to launch, or pruning between batches, is impossible. `evolve inbox ack-fingerprint` needs an item, and `evolve guard list-audit-fails` lists only code-audit-fail entries.
title: Acking a failure fingerprint or pruning failedApproaches happens only as a side effect of launching a loop; add `evolve failures list|reset|prune`
